steps.content:
13:00, July 23, N.F. 113
 Erica Villa, Eastside

steps.speaker: Weather Forecast
steps.content: The current Blue Rain decontamination is drawing to an end. The city's contamination index has stabilized. Rainfall is dwindling progressively and will terminate completely in two hours, after which all city services will resume.

steps.speaker: Weather Forecast
steps.content: Thank you for your support for the city. Have a happy weekend.
Drizzle refracts sunlight on the flower trail. There are few passersby, among which the two women walking one after another with their umbrellas are attracting all the gazes.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: This is the important matter you talked about?

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: Yes. I haven't gone outside for a while. Did some research on Eastside fashion. I'd say I'm quite satisfied with these two outfits.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: I hope the shirt doesn't feel too formal? Undo a few buttons. I bet it'll look even better.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: Hey, quit looking so stiff. Relax, or someone may see through our disguises.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: You call this a disguise?

A passerby recognizes Shalom. He starts coming over cheerfully for a chat, but decides against it the second he sees Rahu's face behind her. In the end, he simply takes off his hat to return Shalom's greeting.
Seeing her smiley face, Rahu sighs.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: You said you'd take me to Paradeisos. I don't see how this is helping.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: And yet, you're here. Haste makes waste. We must wait for a chance.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: I don't have my usual weapon with me. If something goes wrong, I can't guarantee I can settle it with a gun.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: Nothing's gonna go wrong. Trust me.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: I've been to the scene. That woman was pretty badly injured too last night. Without a healing ability like yours, she can only act discreetly before the Blue Rain stops completely.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: Paradeisos is after her. I should have been the one to lure her out, but since you interrupted forcefully and injured her like that...

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: I can only hope she didn't get too demoralized and run away.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: So it's my fault?

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: Haha, of course not. You've brought back some useful intelligence. Now, we can finally take action.
Before blacking out last night, Rahu told Shalom everything she knew. Garofano's own words as well as everything unusual Rahu had noticed.
The assassin had been completely ignorant about Rahu the first two times they fought. But by the third time, she seemed to have grasped the entire history of the FAC warrior.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: The woman is highly dependent on external intelligence. My guess is that between the attack on the 21st and the morning of the 23rd, she must have touched base with her source.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: Could it be the boss of their group?

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: If that reckless assassin group had that kind of intelligence power, it wouldn't have survived till now. They're merely somebody else's knives.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: There's a secret assassin group in Eastside founded by a Mania power from the Underground. It preys on pitiful Sinners, takes advantage of their hatred, and turns them into knives aiming at DisCity.
Rahu thinks of Garofano.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: The power behind these women is hard to tackle. Their discreetness grows with their influence. It's their habit to use hired knives, sharpened with Mania.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: The recent assassinations targeting those in Paradeisos were their doing too. The individual assassins are not Paradeisos's real enemy, these people are. And Paradeisos seeks to eradicate them at all costs.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: And are you part of the costs too?
Shalom laughs, and her face seems to say, Paradeisos is not as you imagine.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: The range you specified was precise. The 9th Agency's agents have begun tracking. I suppose we'll hear from them soon.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: ...What else?

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: I saw a team of unfamiliar faces sneak into your villa, the MBCC's arrest team. Did you arrange that too?

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: Where did you find these people? Are you setting up a trap in your own house to catch Garofano?

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: Good observation.
She flicks the leaf of a flower growing on the side of the trail. The dew spatters onto her hand, leaving faint red marks.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: I hear that the organization is in turmoil now and is no longer capable of arresting Sinners.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: They've lost their director and several inmates are on the loose, so morale is at its bottom. Our operation is likely to succeed. It'll give a boost to their spirits if they can catch the target. They'll surely appreciate this cooperation.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: You can seize this chance to make some friends. They may just come in handy.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: Assuming that the operation is a success and that you can really catch her.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: We will. You've confirmed the assassin's identity for me. More importantly, we now know that Sinner named Garofano is highly attached to her group and the boss. This is good.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: I've prepared some good stuff that has to do with her boss. If she indeed loves her family, she'll show up. Now is the best time since you're away. She'll lower her guard and walk into the trap.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: She doesn't come across as that dumb to me.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: But she's the type to lose her cool once she starts caring. That's why she's accepted such an ambitious request and wants to rope you in. You, a fellow avenger. She's quite sentimental, probably even hiding the truth from her friends.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: Once we've got her, we'll grill her and decide what to do.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: If everything goes as planned, you're coming back to Paradeisos with me.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: ...A bona fide Paradeisos local, always scheming ten steps ahead.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: Be glad. All this scheming is helping you because I'm on your side. Now you don't have to do what you're poor at.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: And what are we doing here, according to your plan?

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: Well, we still have a little free time before catching the assassin. Take a walk with me.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: You dream about going to Paradeisos, but for me, I cherish my time here more.

The two stroll into a small park. Seasonal flowers are in full bloom all over the park, especially vibrant and fresh having been cleansed by the drizzle. Sunlight pours down and glazes them with a pearlescent shine.
Shalom halts all her informative talks and walks into the flowering shrubs, never turning her gaze away from the flowers again. She's smiling and seems genuinely in a mellow mood.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: Once we get back in Paradeisos, I won't get to see flowers like these again.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: People send you bouquets all the time. Isn't your house piled with flowers already?

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: Those are different. What I admire are lives like these. Lives that grow and die naturally, never at anyone's mercy.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: Firmly rooted in the soil and facing the sun and rain openly, they live arduously but eagerly on their own terms. Doomed to wither, they bloom fearlessly. Each has its unique color and embraces death with its immense beauty.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: You can grow your own.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: I don't have a gift for that. Any flower touched by these hands wilts soon.
Rahu falls silent for a moment.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: These flowers were only transplanted here temporarily. They'll be replaced once they're out of bloom to suit the taste of the rich in the villa. The rain is artificial too, a decontamination measure of the city. There's nothing natural or free about either of them.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: But I don't see how they're different from this thing you care so much about. You think that a picked flower becomes a mere decoration. But the way I see it, even if a flower is uprooted and cut, wherever it's brought to, it's still living its life on its own terms.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: A flower doesn't bloom to be looked at.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: You're right.
Shalom folds up the umbrella. She tilts her head back and lets the sheer Blue Rain tint her. Her face blushes faint red as it reacts with Mania.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: Hey!

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: Don't worry, I'm not as vulnerable as you think.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: You're right. What matters most is that we get to see the rare sun shower, and...
She reaches out to catch the glistening, hazy rain. In her blurry vision, Rahu sees a faint gleam slip into her palm.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: Look, a rainbow.

steps.speaker: Maid
steps.content: Miss Shalom. Just as you said, the assassin came back. The new security guards have subdued her and we're all waiting for you to come back. There's just this one thing...

steps.speaker: Maid
steps.content: Just a moment ago, another strange visitor appeared. He demanded to see you as soon as possible, and he said...

steps.speaker: Maid
steps.content: He's brought news from Paradeisos.
